text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san... A package arrived for you in 
our room a moment ago. It looks like it's 
from your family...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's finally arrived! Thank goodness, 
just in time...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's a birthday present for 
Cafe-san, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Since it's for you, Cafe-san, I figured 
coffee would be best... but I don't really 
know anything about it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back home, my dad used to drink it all the 
time... so I just had to ask!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So then, I heard the beans from a black 
cat cafe that opened deep in the mountains 
recently were delicious, so I had them 
sent over.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san, back at your home... Deep in 
the mountains... the black cat...—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"! That place... I think that's the shop 
I've been curious about."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It is well known among coffee 
connoisseurs... However, they do not offer 
mail order. And being deep in rugged 
mountains, it is said that very few have 
ever visited.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...Thank you very much. I'm... so happy."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
! Hehehe... We've gotta thank my dad for 
this. Please, eat as much of it as you'd 
like!
